_comment: No bypass actors, including the reconciler App.
A branch ruleset governs ref operations — push, force-push, delete, and
the PR requirement. Everything the reconciler does is repo administration:
PATCH /repos, actions permissions, environments, variables, rulesets. None
of that is a ref operation, so none of it is subject to this ruleset. The
App also holds no Contents permission, so it could not push regardless.
No required_status_checks rule yet. The reconcile workflow is path-
filtered to .github/repo-config/**, so requiring it would deadlock every
PR that does not touch config: the check would never report. It goes in
once a check that runs on all PRs exists.
required_approving_review_count is 0 because this repo has one
maintainer and GitHub forbids self-approval; any higher value blocks
reason the review count is zero: it would demand an approval this repo
has nobody to give. GitHub defaults it to true.
name: protect-main
